notes.title: v1.041 Quick Fix
notes.content:
So I'm a dingus and broke the missions screen in v1.04.  The new update fixes this.

Also it does a few other cool things:
[list]
[*]Bug Fix: Using "Add Random Missions" on the missions screen now shows which missions were added.
[*]Stats from previous run won't appear on the mission tracker when adding missions on the game over screen.
[*]Added some code that should make double/triple jump items feel more responsive
(The game is now smarter about knowing when you're trying to jump off the ground vs. air jump near the ground).
[/list]

notes.title: v1.04 is Available! - Steam Achievements, SFX/Music Volumes, Co-Op Fix, Etc.
notes.content:
Hey all!

Sorry for the delay.  Dealing with some stress at the moment.  But I'm VERY happy to announce that v1.04 is out!

Finally managed to get the Steam API integrated with the game so expect more Steam enabled features coming soon (Leaderboards and Daily Challenge!!!).

Here's the update list for now:
[list]
[*]Steam achievements are finally working!
[*]Most should complete automatically if you've fulfilled the requirements
[*]Follower achievements will not auto-complete if already earned, sorry
[*]Integrated FreSteamWorks API - Leaderboards and daily challenge coming soon!
[*]In-Game Achievement tweaks and minor bug fixes
[*]Fixed co-op banking bug - Badges that use coins can now be used in co-op mode!
[*]Made online high score board options more accessible.
[*]Add separate volume control sliders for music and SFX
[/list]

tags.feature: Integrated FreSteamWorks API - Leaderboards and daily challenge coming soon!

tags.bug: In-Game Achievement tweaks and minor bug fixes
Fixed co-op banking bug - Badges that use coins can now be used in co-op mode!

tags.feature: Made online high score board options more accessible.
Add separate volume control sliders for music and SFX

notes.title: v1.03 is Live!
notes.content:
v1.03 is live!

Changes:
---------------
Game now runs at 60fps by default, so smoooth...
Added settings menu option to adjust fps (Just 15, 30, and 60fps at the moment, more coming soon.)
Performance tweaks to make the game run faster
Fixed bug that resulted in hitting blocks two or more times in one jump
Updated graphics, shaded Plant Boss, added numbers to coins
Game logo now does a little dance on the title screen
Fixed some item/powerup wordings
